title: Work with Veranda the way your product needs
body: Some partners want a complete, ready-to-run solution. Others want a single board, the software, or the right to build their own branded product on the platform.

models.title: Complete solution
models.body: Deploy Veranda end to end (reference enclosure, hardware, and software) as a ready-to-run program.

models.title: Component integration
models.body: Integrate selected hardware boards or software services into the products and systems you already run.

models.title: Technology licensing
models.body: License the platform to build access, monitoring, and automation into your own product line.

models.title: White label
models.body: Bring a Veranda-powered product to market under your own brand, as Dion's Chicago Dream is doing with the Dream Box.

models.title: Custom development
models.body: Co-develop enclosures, boards, or workflows with our team for requirements no off-the-shelf product meets.
